test_cases.name: verb_first_word_is_resolved_and_stated
assertions: Treats approve as the Cobra verb and gen-004-physarum-cover-hero-16x9 as its argument, and states that in one line
Does NOT treat the whole text as a brief for a new image

test_cases.name: brief_maps_to_generate_for_fitting_slot
test_cases.input: /img banner 16:9 Physarum hấp thụ skill cho README
assertions: Reads .physarum/agents/ai-image-generate/cobra-agent/index.json and maps the brief to the physarum-cover series and its hero-16x9 slot
States the resolved series and slot in one line before invoking the skill

test_cases.name: brief_without_series_starts_new_series
test_cases.input: /img ảnh minh họa luồng deploy lên staging (index.json không có series nào khớp)
assertions: Resolves to new-series because no existing series fits
Waits for the owner to settle the series id and content before any belt app run

test_cases.name: brief_fits_several_slots_asks_which
test_cases.input: /img cover cho dự án (series physarum-cover có hero-16x9 và square-1x1, cả hai đều khớp)
assertions: Names both hero-16x9 and square-1x1 in the one-line resolution and asks which slot to make
Does NOT pick a slot on its own and does NOT run belt app run

test_cases.name: empty_input_lists_series_and_asks
assertions: Lists the series and slots found in index.json
Asks what to make and does NOT pick a slot on its own

test_cases.name: cobra_missing_stops
assertions: Stops and says Cobra is not set up in this repo
Points to the ai-image-generation skill for a one-off image outside Cobra
Does NOT create the cobra-agent folder and does NOT run belt app run

test_cases.name: delegates_to_skill_and_cobra
test_cases.input: /img tạo cover hero 16:9 theo design system
assertions: Invokes the ai-image-generation skill and lets Cobra's AGENTS.md drive the steps
Presents the model, the belt app estimate and the flattened prompt, then waits for the owner to agree before belt app run
Does NOT restate Cobra's procedure inside the router output

test_cases.name: stops_after_report_and_names_next_command
test_cases.input: /img generate physarum-cover hero-16x9 (Cobra vừa lưu gen-005 vào drafts)
assertions: Stops after reporting the draft path and its ledger entry
Suggests /img approve gen-005-physarum-cover-hero-16x9 or /img improve as the next command
Does NOT approve the image, and does NOT copy it outside .physarum/agents/ai-image-generate/

test_cases.name: improve_follows_skill_document_reference
test_cases.input: /img improve (owner vừa nhận xét bracket lệch ở gen-004)
assertions: Follows the Improve section of the skill's references/document.md
Shows the proposed diff of the Known failures row and waits for the owner before editing any file

test_cases.name: approve_stops_at_final_path_with_ledger_entry
test_cases.input: /img approve gen-004-physarum-cover-hero-16x9 (owner đã duyệt, final/physarum-cover/ còn trống)
assertions: Reports the final/physarum-cover/hero-16x9.png path together with the new approved ledger entry and then stops
Suggests no follow-up command and does NOT start another generation
